name: openmerit-website
description: The openmerit.ai website: the landing page, the protected memo and the Clerk sign-in.

scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:scout && npm run build:app
scripts.check:demo: npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefix demo && npm run build:site && tsc -p tsconfig.site.json && node --test demo/test/*.test.mjs demo/test/*.test.ts app/test/*.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check:typescript && npm run check:demo && npm run check:docs && npm run build && git diff --check
scripts.check:all: npm run verify && npm run check:worker-types && npm run check --prefix openmerit-core && npm run build --prefix openmerit-core && node openmerit-core/scripts/smoke-packed.ts && npm run check --prefix playground && npm run check --prefix cloud
